strings.prompt_summary: Summarize in 3 short lines: what is done, current progress, and the next action or decision needed. Write for a watch, with no introduction.
strings.prompt_waiting: What do you need from me? Reply in one or two short sentences for a watch.
strings.prompt_recommend: Take your recommended option and continue.
strings.prompt_computer: I will check on the computer. Wait for me.
strings.phone_timeout: Phone not responding. Check Bluetooth and your VPN, then retry.
strings.link_busy: Connection busy. Press Select to retry.
strings.phone_disconnected: Phone disconnected. Check Bluetooth and retry.
strings.dictation_unavailable: Dictation unavailable. Check your phone connection and retry.
strings.dictation_long: Dictation too long. Try a shorter sentence.
strings.no_microphone: Microphone unavailable. Use a saved reply.
strings.dictation_failed: Cannot start dictation. Check your phone.
strings.no_pending: No pending reply in this thread.
strings.pagination_stalled: T3 pagination stalled. Try refreshing again.
strings.rights_readonly: Read-only connection. Change permissions in settings.
strings.reply_long: Reply too long. Dictate a shorter sentence.
strings.pending_other: A reply is still unconfirmed. Retry the same reply in the same thread.
strings.pending_retry: Sending unconfirmed. Retry the same reply: it will not be sent twice.
strings.secure_url: Use HTTPS or a Tailscale address.
strings.network_failed: Cannot connect. Check T3 and your VPN.
strings.server_timeout: T3 is taking too long to respond.
strings.code_expired: Code expired or already used. Create a new code in T3.
strings.pairing_refused: Connection refused. Check the code and permissions.
strings.server_unknown: T3 does not recognize this connection.
strings.incompatible: This T3 version refused the request.
strings.rights_denied: Insufficient permissions for this thread. Reconnect with suitable permissions.
strings.new_code: Reopen settings and enter a new T3 code.
strings.open_settings: Open T3 settings in the Pebble app.
strings.open_settings_connect: Open T3 settings in the Pebble app to connect.
strings.disconnected: Connection forgotten. Reopen settings to connect.
strings.cfg_server_help: Paste the T3 pairing link to fill the address and code, or enter them separately. Your phone must reach the server, using your VPN if needed.
strings.cfg_code_help: Create a new code in T3 Connections. It is single-use and expires after a few minutes.
strings.cfg_full: Read and reply to all my threads
strings.cfg_read_help: Replies and agent-generated summaries will be disabled.
strings.cfg_write_help: Choose permissions that allow replies to the target thread. Full access permits agent actions without approval.
strings.cfg_crypto: This browser cannot create a secure connection. Update your Pebble app.
strings.cfg_invalid_link: Invalid T3 address or pairing link. Copy a fresh pairing link from T3 Connections.
strings.creation_pending: A creation is still unconfirmed. Resume it from New thread.
strings.creation_unconfirmed: Creation not confirmed. Retry the same draft; T3 will reuse its request ID.
strings.creation_choose_again: Choose the machine and project again from New thread.
strings.creation_connection_changed: An unconfirmed creation belongs to a previous connection. Check T3 before forgetting that connection in settings.
strings.cfg_creation_warning: Forgetting this connection also discards an unconfirmed creation. Check T3 before starting it again.
strings.new_instructions: Press Select to dictate your request. Review the text before creating the thread.
strings.new_microphone: Dictation is unavailable. Check your phone speech service and try again.
strings.creation_storage: Cannot save the creation request on this phone. Free some storage and retry.
